findings.message: Gate fields are incomplete or out of order; expected Actor, Timestamp, Scope, Disposition, Verdict, Rationale, Source revision.
findings.remediation: Replace the table with the canonical template and fill every expected field exactly once in the stated order.

findings.message: Required gate field Disposition is missing or unfilled.
findings.remediation: Record a non-placeholder Disposition value from the applicable authority.

findings.message: Actor is not an attributable human authority.
findings.remediation: Use an exact registered authority identity: 'Human: product owner' or 'Human: designer'. Qualifiers, suffixes, and unregistered identities are not accepted.

findings.message: Source revision is not an immutable accepted revision.
findings.remediation: Record git:<40 lowercase hex> or sha256:<64 lowercase hex>; arbitrary dates, tags, branches, and labels are not trusted.

findings.message: Disposition is missing or outside FULL, LIGHTWEIGHT, WAIVED.
findings.remediation: Record exactly one current Discovery disposition.

findings.message: Discovery verdict is BLOCKED and does not open a downstream gate.
findings.remediation: Resolve the blocking Discovery items and obtain a new human READY or READY_WITH_DEFERRALS acceptance.

findings.message: Discovery acceptance Source revision is stale or unverifiable.
findings.remediation: Revalidate the exact current Vision and Discovery state and record its sha256 digest or a verifiable Git commit.
